2030 Goal: Renewable Electricity 
Description. Achieve 100% renewable electricity 
across our global operations, including manufacturing.
Baseline. During 2020, we had reached 100% renewable 
electricity in our US and European operations, 50% for 
our Israel operations, and 71% globally.
Progress in 2021. We continued our 100% renewable 
electricity commitment for our US, Europe, Israel and 
Malaysia operations, and achieved 80% globally by the 
end of 2021. 
Looking Ahead. We will continue to explore additional 
locations to increase renewable electricity.
